mapper.sql: FROM rbac_user u INNER JOIN rbac_user_role ur ON ur.account_id = u.account_id AND ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN rbac_role r ON r.account_id = ur.account_id AND r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.account_id = r.account_id AND rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN rbac_permission p ON p.account_id = rp.account_id AND p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.account_id = #{accountId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM rbac_user u INNER JOIN rbac_user_role ur ON ur.account_id = u.account_id AND ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN rbac_role r ON r.account_id = ur.account_id AND r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.account_id = #{accountId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code
ORDER BY p.perm_code
